page.overview:
Who is Rudolf Hasse?

Rudolf Hasse (May 30, 1906 - August 12, 1942) was a German racing driver, one of ' original 'Silver Arrows' drivers.

Hasse was born in Mittweida, Saxony, and died while serving on the Russian front during World War II, aged only 36. He won the 1937 Belgian Grand Prix.
